other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Reference to a 52.5 MW cogeneration facility at an airport for energy performance improvement (literature mention, not the paper's own case)
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
A study was carried out at the 52.5 MW cogeneration facility located at
Suvarnabhumi Airport in Thailand to improve energy performance.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Reference to Combined Heating, Cooling and Power (CHCP/trigeneration) systems evaluated at airports (literature mention)

it was determined that a signiﬁcant amount of energy savings could be achieved
by using the Combined Heating,Cooling and Power (CHCP) system.

one_line: The paper is a case study on energy performance indicators and global-warming potential for an airport terminal building (Dalaman International Airport), a commercial/service building context, using regression and LCA methods — no continuous-flow industrial production is studied.
